title: Factory Power Spine
briefing: Commission a readable Tech Wave starter line from Terminal docs to powered automation.

objectives.label: Open Terminal and read Power Basics
objectives.detail: Confirm the player can find the Index pages for generation, batteries, cables, logistics, and runtime safety.

objectives.label: Build a Reinforced Solar Panel or Biofuel Generator
objectives.detail: Use the 1.0.0 Tech Wave generator tier as the first visible stabilized upgrade.

objectives.label: Place a Field Battery Bank
objectives.detail: Buffer 160000 EP near the first generator cluster before routing to machines.

objectives.label: Route High Voltage Cable through a Factory Substation
objectives.detail: Mark the boundary between generation, storage, and the machine hall with the factory_substation_anchor HoloMap marker.

objectives.label: Scan and mark the grid
objectives.detail: Use Lens on one PowerGrid node, then place high_voltage_trunk and field_battery_room HoloMap markers.

objectives.label: Process the first material
objectives.detail: Use an existing Industrial Nexus processor or a pack-specific recipe to prove the line does useful work.

objectives.label: Create a depot-backed automation line
objectives.detail: Use the factory utilities logistics category to move power components or machine parts.

objectives.label: Validate the factory power spine
objectives.detail: Confirm your multiblock structure reports clear missing-block feedback before publishing.

rewards.label: Unlock the Automation Line Index page.
